description.embed_passage: This table presents supplemental coverages for private and commercial vehicle insurance up to 3.5 tons, allowing you to check liability limit increases and self-participation rates for depreciation. You can find information here on possible additions to insurance, such as increasing liability limits and changing the self-participation. The coverages presented include increasing property liability limits to third parties in amounts of ₪ 2,000,000 and ₪ 4,000,000, as well as a 1.5% self-participation in depreciation. Values such as ₪ 4,000,000, ₪ 2,000,000, and 1.5% are also noted.
